# Life Ledger · Deep Review 2.1.0 · Mac 3.1.0

Web **2.1.0** ships **bookkeeping** (Money / 记账 / Finanzen): quick entry, budgets, German CSV import/export, Today **Spending today**, and monthly Review spending with mood/habit/focus insights.

Mac app **3.1.0** bundles the same web assets.

## Highlights since the feature freeze

- **Cross-page spend context:** Today compares spend **vs yesterday**; Week insights add **week spending** (opens Money) with a same-days-last-week hint; Review spending compares **vs last month** on aligned calendar days.
- **Habit & journal context on Week:** completion rate and focus-time tiles caption **vs last week** (percentage points and journal/event days).
- **Recurring fixes:** weekly templates stay due per ISO week; pills and banners count **unposted occurrences**, not template rows only.
- **Spend compare polish:** ±% always uses the **prior period** baseline (drops no longer read −900%); tiny baselines show **money deltas**; increases cap at **+999%**.
- **Today demo insights:** rolling **30-day habit × spend** and **mood × spend** captions with links into Review scatters; Week metric **roll** when changing workspace week.
- **Timeline UX:** feed **skeleton** while photos load; filter changes avoid flash; daily month filter **stale veil** until photos finish; shared **`ll-empty`** art on habits/review misses.
- **Batch 10 polish:** Horizon / habits / timeline / week / review **empty-state CTAs**; Today widget-library onboarding hint; **Done** edit success pulse; review Money scatter empty card; timeline **calendar** empty month CTA (fixed duplicate button ids); extreme spend surges show **money deltas**; backup language restore simplified.
- **QA:** **389** unit + **39** serial headless browser tests (`fakecloud`, Mac shell, ledger/onboarding/empty-state suites).
